mentions.name: SophAI
mentions.description: This app parses RSS feeds and applies a large AI prompt to connect the dots across blog posts from multiple domains (tech, design, business, e-commerce), with podcast support being added.
mentions.problem: Reading across multiple domains (tech, design, business, e-commerce) and having to connect the dots between them is difficult.
mentions.audience: Primarily for the author's own use as a CTO who reads across multiple domains
mentions.source_excerpt: SophAI (https://www.sophai.app/): an app to connect the dots across cross-domain. As a CTO, I read across multiple domains (tech, design, business, e-com) and often have to connect the dots. I am building this primarily for myself. It is basically a rss parser with a big AI prompt to connect the dots across the blog posts. As I type this, I'm working on adding podcasts to the app.
